title: OpenRCT2 Pocket native shop appearance and preview lifecycle
engine: native X8DrawingEngine / ViewportRender / actual Pocket menu onDraw, shop overlay/footer and HUD
fixture: Native initialized 64x64 owned grass map; original Burger, Balloon, Toilet, ATM and Information objects; all placement, edits, demolition/reuse and save/load through native actions/APIs. No guests/customers/income fabricated. Native initial unavailable statistics remain explicit.
inspection: All 28 final PNGs individually inspected at native pixel size in 4-up inspection sheets for clipping, overlap, gold focus, indigo contrast, controls, native park visibility and HUD collisions; sheets excluded.
limitations: Production components and native viewport, not physical Brick captures or a whole SDL framebuffer screenshot. Paused preview uses the native build-in-pause cheat in the isolated fixture. No hardware, dense-park performance, sustained shop operation or multiplayer validation claimed.
